from AlgorithmImports import *


class TwoSlotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
        self.aapl_rsi_values = RollingWindow[float](2)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Update market-state quantities whenever data is available.
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                continue

            close = float(data.Bars[symbol].Close)

            if symbol == self.spy:
                self.spy_closes.Add(close)

            elif symbol == self.aapl:
                self.aapl_closes.Add(close)
                self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, close)

                if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
                    self.aapl_rsi_values.Add(float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value))

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today.
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return

        # Do not trade until every required indicator/window is fully formed.
        if (not self.spy_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_closes.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi_values.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

        spy_sma_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        spy_sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= spy_sma_yesterday and
            self.spy_closes[0] > spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= spy_sma_yesterday and
            self.spy_closes[0] < spy_sma_today
        )

        aapl_red_three_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
            self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
            self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = self.aapl_rsi_values[0] > 60.0

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSmaAndRsiStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.rsi_changes = []
        self.rsi_average_gain = None
        self.rsi_average_loss = None
        self.rsi_value = None
        self.rsi_ready = False

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        self._update_market_state(data)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.rsi_ready:
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self._spy_crosses_below_sma():
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.rsi_value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and self._spy_crosses_above_sma():
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                change = close - self.aapl_previous_close
                gain = max(change, 0.0)
                loss = max(-change, 0.0)

                if not self.rsi_ready:
                    self.rsi_changes.append((gain, loss))
                    if len(self.rsi_changes) == 14:
                        self.rsi_average_gain = sum(x[0] for x in self.rsi_changes) / 14.0
                        self.rsi_average_loss = sum(x[1] for x in self.rsi_changes) / 14.0
                        self.rsi_ready = True
                else:
                    self.rsi_average_gain = (
                        (self.rsi_average_gain * 13.0) + gain
                    ) / 14.0
                    self.rsi_average_loss = (
                        (self.rsi_average_loss * 13.0) + loss
                    ) / 14.0

                if self.rsi_ready:
                    if self.rsi_average_loss == 0:
                        self.rsi_value = 100.0
                    else:
                        relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
                        self.rsi_value = 100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength))

            self.aapl_previous_close = close

    def _spy_crosses_above_sma(self):
        today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
        yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
        today_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        yesterday_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        return yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma and today_close > today_sma

    def _spy_crosses_below_sma(self):
        today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
        yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
        today_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        yesterday_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        return yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma and today_close < today_sma

from collections import deque


class TwoSlotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(
                ticker,
                Resolution.Daily,
                Market.USA,
                False
            ).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                continue
            bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Market-state quantities continue updating whenever their own data exists.
        if self.spy in bars:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(bars[self.spy].Close))

        if self.aapl in bars:
            aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(bars[self.aapl].EndTime, aapl_close)

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing.
        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols):
            return

        # Do not trade until every required indicator/window is fully formed.
        if len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = float(bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)

        closes = list(self.spy_closes)
        yesterday_spy_close = closes[-2]
        yesterday_sma_100 = sum(closes[:-1]) / 100.0
        today_sma_100 = sum(closes[-100:]) / 100.0

        spy_crossed_above = (
            yesterday_spy_close <= yesterday_sma_100
            and spy_close > today_sma_100
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            yesterday_spy_close >= yesterday_sma_100
            and spy_close < today_sma_100
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            quantity = int(target_value // spy_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            purchase_amount = 20_000

            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= purchase_amount:
                quantity = int(purchase_amount // aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_closes = {}
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Keep market-state data current whenever a ticker has a bar.
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                close = data.Bars[symbol].Close

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    previous_close = self.previous_closes.get(symbol)
                    if previous_close is not None and close < previous_close:
                        self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                    else:
                        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                self.previous_closes[symbol] = close

        # Skip all rule evaluation unless every subscribed ticker has a bar.
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                self.spy_sma.Window.Count < 2 or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
        previous_spy_close = self.previous_closes.get(self.spy)

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0:
            crossed_below = (
                previous_spy_close is not None and
                previous_spy_close <= previous_sma and
                spy_close < current_sma
            )
            if crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
                self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        # Strategy A buy.
        if self.spy_lot == 0:
            # The prior close is the most recently stored close before this bar
            # only when using the SMA window for the prior day's SMA value.
            # Retrieve it from the SMA-cross relationship via the prior bar close.
            spy_previous_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            if self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2:
                # The close needed for the cross is retained separately below.
                spy_previous_close = self._GetPreviousCloseForCross(self.spy)

            crossed_above = (
                spy_previous_close is not None and
                spy_previous_close <= previous_sma and
                spy_close > current_sma
            )

            if crossed_above:
                shares = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.spy_lot = shares

        # Strategy B buy.
        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

    def _GetPreviousCloseForCross(self, symbol):
        # Previous close is maintained by a two-value rolling representation
        # through the indicator's prior sample timing.
        # This method is replaced by the value cached before current-bar updates.
        return self._cross_previous_close.get(symbol) if hasattr(self, "_cross_previous_close") else None

            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_closes = {}
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Keep market-state data current whenever a ticker has a bar.
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                close = data.Bars[symbol].Close

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    previous_close = self.previous_closes.get(symbol)
                    if previous_close is not None and close < previous_close:
                        self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                    else:
                        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                self.previous_closes[symbol] = close

        # Skip all rule evaluation unless every subscribed ticker has a bar.
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                self.spy_sma.Window.Count < 2 or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        current_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value
        previous_spy_close = self.previous_closes.get(self.spy)

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0:
            crossed_below = (
                previous_spy_close is not None and
                previous_spy_close <= previous_sma and
                spy_close < current_sma
            )
            if crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
                self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        # Strategy A buy.
        if self.spy_lot == 0:
            # The prior close is the most recently stored close before this bar
            # only when using the SMA window for the prior day's SMA value.
            # Retrieve it from the SMA-cross relationship via the prior bar close.
            spy_previous_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            if self.spy_sma.Window.Count >= 2:
                # The close needed for the cross is retained separately below.
                spy_previous_close = self._GetPreviousCloseForCross(self.spy)

            crossed_above = (
                spy_previous_close is not None and
                spy_previous_close <= previous_sma and
                spy_close > current_sma
            )

            if crossed_above:
                shares = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.spy_lot = shares

        # Strategy B buy.
        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.aapl_lot = shares

    def _GetPreviousCloseForCross(self, symbol):
        # Previous close is maintained by a two-value rolling representation
        # through the indicator's prior sample timing.
        # This method is replaced by the value cached before current-bar updates.
        return self._cross_previous_close.get(symbol) if hasattr(self, "_cross_previous_close") else None

        # Market-state quantities update continuously from any bars that arrive.
        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.symbols["SPY"])
        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(spy_bar.Close))

        aapl_bar = data.Bars.get(self.symbols["AAPL"])
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(IndicatorDataPoint(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close))

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        # A missing bar for any subscribed ticker skips all rule evaluation.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        # Every indicator/window used by a rule must be fully formed.
        if len(self.spy_closes) < 101 or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        yesterday_sma_100 = sum(closes[:100]) / 100.0
        today_sma_100 = sum(closes[1:]) / 100.0

        spy_crossed_above = (
            closes[-2] <= yesterday_sma_100 and
            spy_close > today_sma_100
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            closes[-2] >= yesterday_sma_100 and
            spy_close < today_sma_100
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and
            self.strategy_a_pending_order is None and
            spy_crossed_below
        ):
            ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_pending_order = ticket.OrderId

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and
            self.strategy_b_pending_order is None and
            self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        ):
            ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_pending_order = ticket.OrderId

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and
            self.strategy_a_pending_order is None and
            spy_crossed_above
        ):
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], shares)
                self.strategy_a_pending_order = ticket.OrderId

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and
            self.strategy_b_pending_order is None and
            self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and

        ):

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):

            if order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_a_pending_order:

                self.strategy_a_pending_order = None

            elif order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_b_pending_order:
                self.strategy_b_lot += order_event.FillQuantity
                self.strategy_b_pending_order = None

        elif order_event.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
            if order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_a_pending_order:
                self.strategy_a_pending_order = None
            elif order_event.OrderId == self.strategy_b_pending_order:
                self.strategy_b_pending_order = None
